# isomer — https://isomer-demo.fly.dev
# See https://llmstxt.org/

> isomer is a shared library of AI governance content (requirements, questions,
> mappings) plus Elixir/Surreal tooling and a Phoenix LiveView assessment UI.

The content corpus lives as YAML/Markdown in the GitHub repo. SurrealDB is the
system of record for synced corpus rows and assessment tenancy. The web app is
a projector over Surreal record-auth sessions (no parallel Ecto user table).

## Product

- Assessment UI (demo): https://isomer-demo.fly.dev
- Source: https://github.com/pyr0gan/isomer
- Docs in-repo: README.md, docs/assessment-runtime.md, docs/deploy.md, docs/versioning.md

## Public URLs

- /login — sign in / sign up
- /health — liveness probe (plain text `ok`)
- /robots.txt — crawler policy
- /.well-known/security.txt — vulnerability disclosure
- /llms.txt — this file

Authenticated app routes (`/orgs`, `/assessments`, …) require a Surreal user
JWT session and are not useful to anonymous crawlers.

## Frameworks in the corpus

- annex-sl-core / 1.0
- ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AIMS)
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (ISMS)
- EU AI Act (2024+2026-1744 obligations + classification ruleset)

## Optional

- GitHub issues / PRs for tooling and content changes
- CycloneDX SBoM via `mix isomer.sbom` (dev)
